title: Serve parity: Alpaca IEX clock-hour 1h bars (incl. extended hours) vs the regular-session :30 bars RQ-20261101-bdc2-01 scored ml_entry on; measure the feature and decision-clock difference on alpaca_paper
note: Filed 2026-11-01 by lane ALPACA-LIVE-ACTIVITY-ML on the manager instruction (12:37Z): "file a dated serve-parity row: owner manager, due_by 2026-11-03, measuring the difference between Alpaca IEX clock-hour bars and regular-session bars. Paper can proceed." MEASURED in code: src/exchange/alpaca_connector.py::get_ohlcv requests /v2/stocks/{sym}/bars with the IEX feed and no session filter; bar t = bar START on the clock hour, so live 1h bars include pre/post-market trades and differ from the Yahoo regular-session :30 bars the one-read scored. Consequences to measure: (1) is_decision_bar fires at UTC close hours %4==0 incl. extended-hours bars (00/08/12 UTC) where a bracket cannot be placed; (2) ret_k / vol24 / ATR14 / range_pos counted over extended-hours bars. Method: pull 30 sessions of Alpaca IEX 1h bars and Yahoo RTH bars for the 13 alpaca_paper ETFs, compute the 20 features at each decision bar both ways, report the per-feature gap and the decision agreement (taken / side) of the frozen model.

observation.what: per-feature gap and decision agreement, Alpaca IEX clock-hour bars vs regular-session bars, ml_entry on the 13 alpaca_paper ETFs
observation.how_to_check: a committed comparison under comms/research/ml_entry_alpaca_bar_parity/ with the 20 features both ways at every decision bar of 30 sessions
